end.rule: C-S8-72 (spec rev. 67 345.1): LEVEL-time event: first READY after the event + 5 s, at most event + 50 s; upper bound duration + 60 s, else timeout

pressure_floor.rule: S8-A1: p_h = max(floor, (F_p + p_r A_ann) / A_p), p_r re-solved where it binds; floor = return 2 bar g moving, rod-side cavitation floor locked

F1_law.rule: |F_hat - (F - f + E_s)| <= 6 sigma_F + 0.1 kN (R45-1, U-S8-18), raw reading F_hat_N, phases other than CHECK

F1.rule: |F_hat - F| <= F_s,leg + 0.1 kN (ideal sensor), phases other than CHECK

F2.note: max_raw_minus_band = F_hat - F_band - F (control rev. 43 recheck basis); max_reading_lower = F_lower_N - F (rev. 42 judge, no band)

item9.fallback_note: level judgements on F_hat / F_lower only (no R-5, GE2, probe); the P-S8-1 replay rows below supersede them when present

replay.reading_rule: C-S8-40 / spec rev. 54 249 (C-S8-37 / rev. 52 232 corrected): default = corrected reading lower_reading + delta_i (and net_force + delta_i) on the 10 Hz samples whose pad normal force (pads N_raw, 1 ms record, linear interpolation at the sample time) is < 1.5 kN, delta_i = min(0.5 kN, 2 F_s,i), F_s,i = median of pads F_seal_limit[:, i], only for engine L2b_NSC (settings.s8.engine), else 0; 'raw' = the reading as recorded (record rows); 'upper_sensitivity' = lifted samples (N <= 0) read at least F_seal_limit,i - m_i g (sensitivity rows); 'all_apply' = + 0.5 kN where N < 1.5 kN regardless of engine / F_s (rev. 52 rule, sensitivity rows)

deferred_min.rule: C-S8-41 / C-S8-42 (spec rev. 54 261, rev. 55 267, U-S8-57 (a)): per leg_reapproach_deferred:<leg> after the event, window = deferral t_def .. min(t_next, t_def + T_o) + 0.3 s, cut at the run end (t_next = the same leg's next leg_reapproach_start, T_o = controller meta r8.lifted_reapproach.opposite_window_s, 0.8 s when missing); overlapping windows of the same leg are merged (first deferral .. last end); value = minimum of the S8-A2 judged true rod force (pads F_cyl_min_interval, 20 ms mean F_cyl_mean_20ms on airborne samples) of that leg over the window; the raw 1 ms minimum and the lift are records too; FLAG (record, not a gate) when the judged minimum < F_min

rt.rule: C-S8-40 (spec rev. 54 248.3): W = sum over the 1 ms pad record of D/2 (n . u_applied) dt per 0.5 s bin from the event, 8 s, D = (F_FL + F_RR) - (F_FR + F_RL) - D0 (true rod forces pads F_cyl, D0 = median over event - 0.5 .. 0 s), n = (+,-,-,+)/2, u_applied from record.npz held between samples; power 0 in the forced window [forced start, done_s + 0.1 s] (to the run end when done_s is None); judged bins = bins starting >= event + 1.5 s with an unmasked sample; cluster = consecutive judged bins > +20 J; judged: clusters <= 1 (recurrence ban; ASSUMPTION 254). Records: the rev. 52 unmasked bin max (raw_max_bin_after_J), the masked bin max and the largest cluster work

event_state.rule: spec rev. 67 345.1: phase = event start - reference (a 10 Hz control sample); phase at the event = the controller phase in force at the event start; LEVEL-time cases in another phase are phase_mismatch (not judgeable)

s8_end.rule: C-S8-72 (spec rev. 67 345.1): LEVEL-time event: first READY after the event + 5 s, at most event + 50 s; upper bound duration + 60 s, else timeout

g1.rule: C-S8-72 (spec rev. 67 345.2): U-S8-32 event legs (settled + diagonal) cumulative lift <= 1.8 s, last re-contact <= event + 3.0 s, FAULT 0 and U57 adjacent (#1-9, 11; outside-window part with the U-S8-75 (b) exception); U58 window <= 350 / outside extension <= 180 bar (#1-11); F_min per U-S8-74 (a) (spec rev. 68 354.1, replaces the 345.2 fast-event F_min row): over [W end, run end] every leg (a) the minimum of the trailing 0.5 s moving mean of the S8-A2 judged force (full windows ending at >= W end + 0.5 s) >= F_min AND (b) no pad lift (airborne = 20 ms pad normal <= 0: 0 samples; old records without airborne: judged force > 0, airborne_source force_sign_fallback; U-S8-75 = (b) (spec rev. 68 357.3): fast event (settle speed > v_max) on a front leg (FL / FR), top level, case F_s < 2 kN: the U57 adjacent lift outside the window and the U-S8-74 F_min (b) lift after the window end pass when the adjacent-leg lift after the window sums to <= 0.1 s with a gap <= 0.5 mm (FLAG 'U-S8-75 (b) exception'); event legs must not lift after the window end; the 0.5 s mean (a) is unchanged; outside the scope unchanged); not judgeable when the run ends before W end + 0.5 s; the 1 ms instantaneous minimum is a record row (FLAG when < F_min) with the time below F_min, the longest run below F_min, the time below 0 and the lift time; slow event (G4, #10): 1 ms minimum after the event >= F_min (unchanged); end READY + last 1 s mean |att| <= 0.2 deg; recurrence ban 248.3 (twist work clusters <= 1); phase_mismatch (controller phase at the event start other than the expected one) = not judgeable

u_s8_32.rule: U-S8-32 (spec rev. 48 218.5) / U-S8-37 (rev. 49 219.3): event legs = settled + diagonal, adjacent = the other two; U57 physical window (spec 62) on the adjacent legs; event legs: cumulative lift <= 1.8 s, last re-contact <= event + 3.0 s (gate; <= 2.5 s nominal-damping flag column), FAULT 0 (ASSUMPTION)

F_min_after.rule: U-S8-74 (a) (spec rev. 68 354.1, replaces the 345.2 fast-event F_min row): over [W end, run end] every leg (a) the minimum of the trailing 0.5 s moving mean of the S8-A2 judged force (full windows ending at >= W end + 0.5 s) >= F_min AND (b) no pad lift (airborne = 20 ms pad normal <= 0: 0 samples; old records without airborne: judged force > 0, airborne_source force_sign_fallback; U-S8-75 = (b) (spec rev. 68 357.3): fast event (settle speed > v_max) on a front leg (FL / FR), top level, case F_s < 2 kN: the U57 adjacent lift outside the window and the U-S8-74 F_min (b) lift after the window end pass when the adjacent-leg lift after the window sums to <= 0.1 s with a gap <= 0.5 mm (FLAG 'U-S8-75 (b) exception'); event legs must not lift after the window end; the 0.5 s mean (a) is unchanged; outside the scope unchanged); not judgeable when the run ends before W end + 0.5 s; the 1 ms instantaneous minimum is a record row (FLAG when < F_min) with the time below F_min, the longest run below F_min, the time below 0 and the lift time; slow event (G4, #10): 1 ms minimum after the event >= F_min (unchanged)
